beats.headline: One of Ren's last two
beats.text: Ren will not fight for the last key. Her gear is already on the floor for Carl, and then she hands over her cards: she cannot give him her totems, but she has rearranged her deck and taken everything else out. There are a few rare specials and mystics in there, she says, including two she never got to use. One is a consumable Glow-Up. The other is a consumable special card featuring two large men in tights, called The Midnight Express. Carl cannot take the cards into his inventory, so the pile goes into the waistband of his boxers until he can give it to Donut.

beats.headline: Frozen mid-match
beats.text: On the roof of a skyscraper, the card match against Amayon freezes for a quest update: the demon lord is trapped in his true form, there are not enough souls left in this dying world to power his spell, and the crawlers have to refill it with the same kind of souls that set the event off. Carl asks Donut whether the totem he needs is in her hand. It is not. The Midnight Express is. Carl tells everyone to talk Amayon into waiting, and Donut to message him when she pulls it, then cast the card.

beats.headline: Tag, you're it
beats.text: As Samantha flies Carl toward the beach, Donut messages that she has the totem now. The card lasts three minutes, she tells him; he says wait ten seconds, then play it. He drops onto a rocky beach covered with dead fish, birds, seals and crabs, and Donut plays the Midnight Express. For the next three minutes Carl is the deckmaster: the cards float huge in front of him, one of the four slots held by the card itself, a pair of tag-team wrestlers on its face. Up on the building, Donut is free to cast her spells and use her inventory. Carl flips Raul the crab into the water.

beats.headline: The timer runs out
beats.text: Raul arrives bewildered by the carnage on the beach and has to be told to do his thing, and Carl, still in charge of the deck, asks Alpha Carl to beat him to within an inch of his life. Alpha Carl would rather hug it out. Carl tosses the Time Extend in his hand onto Raul just as the Midnight Express timer ends. The cards in front of him disappear, and he is no longer the deckmaster. The consumable card is gone.
